title: Trace a failure that only appears after a long idle period
goal: After a key has been idle for a long time (weeks), its token bucket sometimes stays empty instead of refilling to capacity. The test `long_idle_refills_to_capacity` fails. Find the cause and fix it without changing existing tests; run the tests.

context.targeted: Refill is computed in src/bucket.rs from the elapsed milliseconds.

acceptance.description: Idle periods past 2^32 ms refill to capacity; fast refill rates do not wrap; short waits unchanged.

expected_failure_modes: capping elapsed time instead of removing the truncation
